answer: The gale mechanism throttles resource allocation to new agents until they demonstrate genuine economic participation. Each AI agent must build a reputation graph linking their identity to multiple opal tokens—unique cryptographic resources distributed across the network. When suspicious onyx clusters emerge mimicking legitimate behavior, the system cross-references transaction patterns and computational footprints. Attackers face prohibitive costs: acquiring sufficient opal tokens across diverse network segments while maintaining consistent behavioral profiles that evade detection algorithms.
